response.query: What dose–response and intensity estimands should we pre-specify (e.g., marginal effect per 0.1 SD), and which IV/LATE estimators will identify partial compliance effects?
response.answer: Pre-specify marginal effect per 0.1 SD for dose–response. Use LATE and PLIVM estimators to identify partial compliance effects. Focus on complier average causal effect (CACE) for IV methods.
